title: RouteAlign: Aligning Task Requirements with Model Profiles for LLM Service Selection
title_zh: RouteAlign：面向大语言模型服务选择的对齐任务需求与模型画像

paragraphs.en: RouteAlign通过对齐任务需求与模型画像来选择LLM服务，扩展了质量-成本前沿。 LLM service selection requires performance evidence that reflects the demands of the current task. Aggregate scores obscure differences in capability and difficulty, while semantically related examples can involve different combinations of skills. We present RouteAlign, which uses task requirements to structure both the measurement of model performance and the selection of services. Task requirements describe capability demand and difficulty, enabling alignment with corresponding model performance measurements. Historical requirements determine how outcomes contribute to global profiles and local capability estimates; incoming requirements determine how those measurements inform the current decision. A shared scorer integrates the evidence, and a generation-cost preference controls selection among eligible services. Evaluation across diverse tasks and heterogeneous LLM services shows that RouteAlign extends the empirical quality-cost frontier toward higher task quality. Comparisons with open Jev-style decision backends show consistent quality gains, with lower generation cost than their strongest tested configuration. Ablations support the contribution of local performance evidence, while catalog-update experiments demonstrate effective reuse of the fitted scorer with refreshed model measurements.
paragraphs.zh: RouteAlign 通过对齐任务需求与模型画像来选择 LLM 服务，扩展了质量-成本前沿。LLM 服务选择需要能够反映当前任务需求的性能证据。 聚合分数掩盖了能力与难度上的差异，而语义相关的示例可能涉及不同的技能组合。 我们提出 RouteAlign，它利用任务需求来构建模型性能度量和服务的挑选结构。 任务需求描述了能力需求与难度，从而能与相应的模型性能度量实现对齐。 历史需求决定结果如何贡献于全局画像与局部能力估计；新到来的需求决定这些度量如何为当前决策提供依据。 一个共享的评分器整合这些证据，一个生成成本偏好控制在符合条件的各服务之间进行选择。 在多样任务与异构 LLM 服务上的评估表明，RouteAlign 将经验性的质量-成本前沿扩展到更高的任务质量。 与开放的 Jev 风格决策后端的比较显示出一致的质量提升，且生成成本低于其测试过的最强配置。 消融实验支持局部性能证据的贡献，而目录更新实验表明，在模型度量刷新后仍可有效复用已拟合的评分器。
